scientific_stage: M2-B6 external graph white-box evaluation of the already-frozen M2-B5 joint ensemble
purpose: Evaluate the frozen M2-B5 equal-weight ensemble mean and finite-portfolio ambiguity range against the frozen Phase-1 graph white-box reference, while comparing M0 and the same-seed B5 M1 baseline on the identical A_G/rho/H support.

whitebox_input.role: external evaluation only after B5 predictions and B6 prediction-freeze manifest are materialized

evaluation_semantics.M1_source: sigma_m1_same_seed_bank from the frozen B5 ensemble curve
evaluation_semantics.M2_source: sigma_m2_mean and [sigma_m2_min,sigma_m2_max] from the frozen B5 ensemble curve
evaluation_semantics.Jaccard_D_A: N/A because A_G is held fixed across WB, M0, M1, and M2

primary_ambiguity_metrics.interpretation: The range is model ambiguity across the frozen diverse 27-member portfolio. It is not a statistical confidence interval and is not a proven global bound over all I1-compatible latent models.

monte_carlo_uncertainty.reason: Keep finite-trajectory statistical uncertainty separate from the already-frozen M2 model-ambiguity range. A seed-cluster bootstrap may be added later as a separately frozen diagnostic.

evidence_status.prospective_claim_requirement: Evaluate the already-frozen M2 semantics unchanged on at least one untouched predeclared graph/workload/admissibility condition.

next_gate: Interpret M0/M1/M2 point accuracy together with M2 ambiguity-range coverage and width. Do not retune M2 from G0 white-box results. Then define the untouched prospective validation condition before making a strong M2 claim.
